2124637984179781690.en_summary: Bears finally got their moment last week after predicting AI top for 4 years, but in 3-6 months this will be seen as just a correction; narrative of $NVDA collapse is extreme as it was at record high Oct 6 nearly $6T, even half guided revenue ~$400B annual, S&P strong earnings, Friday 4.1 SD below 50dma more extreme than 2020/2008, AI buildout accelerating, bears sound smart bulls make money.
2124637984179781690.zh_summary: 空頭在預測 AI 頂部 4 年後終於迎來時刻，但 3-6 個月後這將被視為只是調整；$NVDA 崩潰的敘事極端，因為它在 10 月 6 日創下近 6 萬億美元的記錄高點，即使是指導收入的一半也接近 4000 億美元年度收入，標普有強勁盈利增長，上週五收盤低於 50 日均線 4.1 個標準差，比 2020/2008 更極端，AI 建設加速，空頭聽起來聰明，多頭賺錢。

2124635697562755462.en_summary: Discusses $RKLB has lots of capital and scaling rapidly vs $FLT needing capital; collaborating with $ASTS allows Firefly to access capital to scale Eclipse as quickly as RKLB scales Neutron; deal is transformational, Firefly lunar landers don't compete with ASTS, more collaboration possible.
2124635697562755462.zh_summary: 討論 $RKLB 有大量資本並快速擴張，而 $FLT 需要大量資本；與 $ASTS 合作讓 Firefly 能夠獲得足夠資本以與 RKLB 擴張 Neutron 一樣快地擴張 Eclipse；交易具有變革性，Firefly 的月球登陸器不與 ASTS 競爭，未來可能有更多合作。
